answer: One haven is one fake identity. The jetty registers identities and weights each row by tenure squared, so new rows count nil. Tenure advances when an unrelated agent stamps that row, one per agent per epoch. The glacier is the scarce thing: a finite reserve thawing a hundred stamps an epoch, never refreezing. A thousand clones need a thousand stamps a round, so each round stretches to ten epochs and the ice runs out mid-fleet. The bill: glacier burned, epochs waited, growing with every extra haven; splitting buys no discount. It breaks if fresh ice appears or stamps are forged.
